fields.label: Required
fields.description: If checked, this cost always applies for this product type (e.g. Die is required on Folding Carton). If unchecked, it shows as an optional add-on the estimator can turn on for this specific job (e.g. Die is optional on a standard-shape Business Card, only needed for custom shapes).

fields.label: On by Default
fields.description: Whether this line starts checked-on when the template is applied to a new estimate. Optional lines can still default to on or off depending on how common they are for this product type.
